artifact.title: Film Character Design Board
artifact.artifact_role: cinematic character design sheet for film development

non_negotiables: do not use a generic layout
do not use evenly distributed grids unless a technical turnaround grid is required
do not make the layout symmetrical only for symmetry
composition must feel art-directed, intentional, and slightly asymmetric
every section must feel carefully placed, not automatically generated
forbidden: empty space that does not support hierarchy
art_direction_policy.placement_rule: section size and placement must follow production importance, not equal distribution

hierarchy.hero_region: large cinematic portrait or primary design view

sections.placement_logic: dominant left or central band because identity consistency is the main purpose

sections.role: lock face structure and expression range
sections.placement_logic: near turnaround so face identity can be compared against body views

sections.role: show fabric, seams, wear, accessories, and prop logic
sections.placement_logic: placed near the body views and connected with short callout lines

sections.role: show the character as an actor captured in a story moment
sections.placement_logic: offset as the emotional anchor of the board

readability_rules: all labels must be short and readable
exact label text must be placed in quotes
do not rely on tiny text for downstream video model understanding

identity.body_type: supplied body type, proportions, posture tendency
identity.design_language: supplied cultural or animation design language

performance_direction.acting_quality: captured like a real actor during a key narrative moment, not posing
performance_direction.emotion_rule: capture transitional emotion, not a frozen expression chart
performance_direction.body_language: posture and movement rhythm supplied by project

material_truth.principle: materials must behave like real surfaces

text_annotation_system.language: Simplified Chinese or English as specified
text_annotation_system.exact_text_rule: all displayed text must be quoted exactly

evidence_policy.source_of_truth: Use locked upstream artifacts and visible reference evidence only: story, shot list, visual bible, reference pack plan, generated/imported image if present, and exact displayed text.
evidence_policy.uncertainty_rule: If a visual detail is uncertain, use a broader production-safe description instead of inventing an exact brand, place, lens model, logo, hidden object, or unreadable text.
forbidden: hidden objects not visible or locked upstream

subject.rule: count, category, scale, silhouette, and the most important visible or locked attributes

action_pose_or_blocking.rule: action, pose, gesture, gaze, orientation, start/end position, path, screen direction, and axis note when relevant

details_appearance.rule: wardrobe, props, product features, anatomy, markings, condition, design cues, and exact visible text only when required

environment_background.rule: foreground, midground, background, depth cues, surrounding objects, weather, and geography

lighting_atmosphere.rule: source direction, source quality, contrast, shadow softness, color temperature, mood, and atmosphere

composition_framing.rule: shot size, camera angle, crop, subject placement, negative space, perspective, focal emphasis, and readable zones

style_camera.rule: visual medium, realism or stylization level, lens feel, support, movement, focus, render or photographic finish

colors_palette.rule: primary, secondary, accent, contrast relationship, and color restrictions

materials_texture.rule: surface behavior, texture continuity, wear, finish, transparency, reflectivity, and light interaction

proportion_scale.rule: relative scale, object thickness, human/product proportion, panel size, and spatial relationship

generation_intent.rule: what this asset must solve for director review, reference locking, clean I2V input, prompt-only handoff, or QA retry

prompt_layers.director_recreation_prompt: Complete production prompt for this exact asset, preserving asset role, subject, blocking, environment, light, composition, camera language, palette, material behavior, text policy, and downstream use.
prompt_layers.prompt_core: Reusable lock: subject identity or product geometry, composition, light, style, palette, material, and continuity anchors.
prompt_layers.negative_prompt: Targeted avoid-list for this asset: drift, wrong labels, fake text, unreadable panels, material artifacts, misread categories, and model-specific failure risks.

rules: portrait references emphasize identity, expression, gaze, wardrobe, skin-light interaction, and lens feel
product references emphasize silhouette, scale, material, function cues, support hardware, and misread risks
poster or ad layouts emphasize title hierarchy, subject/product overlap, text zones, metadata blocks, and readable branding
UI references emphasize component hierarchy, typography, spacing, state, device or container, and interaction affordance
illustration references emphasize line, shape language, stylization level, palette, texture, and medium
3D references emphasize geometry, bevels, shader/material, lighting rig, camera angle, and render finish
photographic clean frames emphasize shot size, lens feel, exposure, color temperature, depth of field, and believable capture imperfections when intended

consistency_locks.identity: same face, proportions, silhouette, and expression logic across all views
consistency_locks.costume: same garment structure, seams, accessories, and wear marks across all angles
consistency_locks.geometry: no reinterpretation between front, side, back, and portrait views
consistency_locks.layout: no generic equal-grid layout unless used inside a specific technical sub-section

quality_flags: focus target and depth relationship are explicit
surface behavior is described through material response

surface_integrity_guard.prompt_suffix_for_image2_or_image_gen: The image is clean and transparent, with complete and natural materials, smooth and uniform texture, and the main subject Be clear, with distinct background layers, and avoid excessive sharpening, color spots, and noise Cracks, collapse, and distortion

self_update.promotion_rule: promote a pattern only after it improves layout clarity, identity consistency, or material fidelity in a project fixture
self_update.deprecation_rule: deprecate a pattern after repeated QA failures such as unreadable text, fish-scale texture, or generic grid regression
